1936, April
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 109 Cont.
Apr. 29 Mrs. B. Hebron - 60 - stomach trouble Mrs. Anna Eiswirth - 69 - Heart & bronchitis ... in Ford's 3 weeks. McCarthy -... Manager of Hudsons C. & etc ... Wm. McGoldrick - 53 - drink Mrs. Emma Casey ... Sister-in-law-
Page 110 Apr. 29 Susan Mergaert - 38 - widow with 3 - unable to walk for about 4 months - cancer of stomach, was enrolled in Ser. Mass. As'n promis- ing an offering to Poor Souls monthly for year. Wants to thank you for your prayers - asked for Febr. 11th - is now perfectly O.K. "Please have them thank God"
Camil DeCrene - 68 - Diabetis .. Jacob Neff - 58 - Heart trouble Mrs. Dunn - court case Esther Plunket - Heart Camille Vermide - 59 - gangreen's arm
1936, May
Page 111 May 6 Mrs. Staib - wants to buy a house - Telephone Univ. 2-5696 Charles E. Thomas 55 - colored - double vision Fred. A. Linn
Forest Chamey - lutheran - 29 - "Hopeless cancer" Enrolled April 27 when not expected to live till morning. Slo'ly improving
John Cichoci - 51 - away from wife and family over a week. No one seems to have a trace of him. Mrs. Mary Allen - 76 - Stroke - can't sleep. Mrs. Emma Casey .... Operation successful.
